answer: Standing decays every epoch, so an identity that stops working slides toward the nadir. Attestations from a single subnet are taxed, which removes the discount a farm gets from vouching for itself. Every claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain, and a failed check costs the ferrous bond behind it. An operator can park identities on a quiet knoll, but idle standing bleeds and the parked set is worth nothing when called on. Sustained presence is the only thing that keeps a score alive.
